output.summary: 证据描述 vLLM 服务 MOSS-Audio 模型时的资源耗尽风险：可访问 /tokenize 端点的客户端能提供请求控制的 mm_processor_kwargs；MOSS-Audio 用这些值构造 MossAudioProcessor 实例并存入无界私有字典，每个处理器包含已分配 mel-filter 数组的 WhisperFeatureExtractor。攻击者可反复提交不同处理器配置造成持续线性内存增长，或提供超大 mel_config 值放大单次请求分配，从而耗尽主机内存并使 API 进程终止或严重降级。证据还指出 /tokenize 有意不在 vLLM 的 API 密钥保护路由前缀内，因此仅靠 --api-key 无法限制访问该端点。
output.quoted_evidence:
When vLLM serves a MOSS-Audio model, a client that can access the /tokenize endpoint can provide request-controlled
  mm_processor_kwargs.

  MOSS-Audio uses these values to construct MossAudioProcessor instances and stores every distinct instance in an
  unbounded private dictionary. Each processor contains a WhisperFeatureExtractor with an allocated mel-filter array.

  An attacker can therefore:

  1. Repeatedly submit distinct processor configurations to cause persistent linear memory growth.
  2. Supply oversized mel_config values to amplify the allocation made by a single request.

  This can exhaust host memory and terminate or severely degrade the API process. /tokenize is intentionally outside
  vLLM’s API-key-protected route prefixes, so --api-key alone does not restrict access to this endpoint.
